duties: creates the project SPSCRING from the ecss template, grants the project manager; hangs SPSCRING under KYR once KYR's baseline is on the box
grants the team; writes the package overview and the tailoring; plans the reviews; raises the change requests on the documentation

the customer's representative (KYR, the platform): writes the requirements baseline (SSS, IRD, SOW and their requirements); takes KYR's baseline as the input; closes the SRR, the PDR and the QR; approves the ICD and the PDR and QR baselines
requirements and interfaces: the SRS, the ICD, the assumptions and the sources; derives the SRS from the requirements baseline
design and code: the components, the decisions, the SDD, the SUM and the API reference; files the code and the repository's documents into the space
verification: the cases, the SVS and the SVR; records the release pipeline's runs at the release commit with their logs as evidence
independent reviewer: opens each review and raises the RIDs
product assurance: approves the items, the RIDs' dispositions and the change requests; closes the CDR; approves the SRR and CDR baselines
configuration: freezes each review's baseline at the release commit
